        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import os

os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)

def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # dividers: full rows/cols of same nonzero color
    div_rows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i]))==1 and grid[i][0]!=0]
    div_cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==grid[0][j] and grid[0][j]!=0 for i in range(h))]
    row_bounds=[]; prev=0
    for r in div_rows: row_bounds.append((prev,r)); prev=r+1
    row_bounds.append((prev,h))
    col_bounds=[]; prev=0
    for c in div_cols: col_bounds.append((prev,c)); prev=c+1
    col_bounds.append((prev,w))
    cells=[[grid[r0+r][c0+c] for c in range(len(range(c0,c1))) ] for r0,r1 in row_bounds for c0,c1 in col_bounds]
    nr=len(row_bounds); nc=len(col_bounds)
    cellm=[[grid[row_bounds[i][0]+r][col_bounds[j][0]+c] for c in range(col_bounds[j][1]-col_bounds[j][0])] for i in range(nr) for j in range(nc)]
    cellm=[[cellm[i*nc+j] for j in range(nc)] for i in range(nr)]
    # find key: cell with a pattern that is not a solid 2x2 square? key cell = the one whose color count/shape unique... 
    # heuristic: cell containing more than 4 colored pixels OR shape unlike others; in both cases key has 6-8 pixels
    key=None
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            m=cellm[i][j]; c=set(x for row in m for x in row if x)
            if len(c)==1 and sum(x!=0 for row in m for x in row)>4:
                key=m; kc=c.pop()
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    dv=grid[div_rows[0]][0]
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            m=cellm[i][j]; cols=set(x for row in m for x in row if x)
            if len(cols)!=1: continue
            c=cols.pop()
            if c==dv: continue
            r0,c0=row_bounds[i][0],col_bounds[j][0]
            for r in range(len(key)):
                for cc in range(len(key[0])):
                    out[r0+r][c0+cc]= c if key[r][cc]==kc else 0
    return out

    div_rows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i]))==1 and grid[i][0]!=0]
    div_cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]==grid[0][j] and grid[0][j]!=0 for i in range(h))]
    row_bounds=[]; prev=0
    for dr in div_rows: row_bounds.append((prev,dr)); prev=dr+1
    row_bounds.append((prev,h))
    col_bounds=[]; prev=0
    for dc in div_cols: col_bounds.append((prev,dc)); prev=dc+1
    col_bounds.append((prev,w))
    nr=len(row_bounds); nc=len(col_bounds)
    cellm=[]
    for i in range(nr):
        r0=row_bounds[i][0]
        for j in range(nc):
            c0=col_bounds[j][0]
            cellm.append([[grid[r0+r][c0+c] for c in range(col_bounds[j][1]-col_bounds[j][0])] for r in range(row_bounds[i][1]-row_bounds[i][0])])
    cellm=[[cellm[i*nc+j] for j in range(nc)] for i in range(nr)]
    key=None; kn=0
    keypos=None
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            m=cellm[i][j]; n=sum(x!=0 for row in m for x in row)
            if n>kn: kn=n; key=m; keypos=(i,j)
    kc=[x for row in key for x in row if x][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i in range(nr):
        cnt=Counter()
        for j in range(nc):
            if (i,j)==keypos: continue
            cnt.update(x for row in cellm[i][j] for x in row if x)
        bc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
        for j in range(nc):
            r0,c0=row_bounds[i][0],col_bounds[j][0]
            for r in range(len(key)):
                for cc in range(len(key[0])):
                    out[r0+r][c0+cc]= bc if key[r][cc]==kc else 0
    return out
